name: ai-interview-questions-mcp
description: 100 graded AI Engineer interview questions with model answers, plus a mock interview prompt.
long_description: Practice AI Engineer interviews inside Claude: LLM fundamentals, prompting, RAG, agents and MCP, fine-tuning, evaluation, AI system design, production and coding. Search questions, draw random practice sets, read model answers with frameworks, follow-ups and common mistakes, or run a full mock interview. Offline, no API keys, no telemetry.
